reasons: CS4223 requires (CS2106 or CG2271) AND (CS3210 or CS3220 or CG3207).
The student has completed CS2106, satisfying the first part of the prerequisite.
However, the student has not completed CS3210, CS3220, or CG3207, nor are they planned.

Rule 8 prohibits adding courses not requested by the student unless they are prerequisites for a planned course. CS4223 is a required course, but its prerequisites (CS3210/CS3220/CG3207) are not prerequisites for any other required course (CS3219, CS2102, CS2105). Therefore, these prerequisites cannot be added to the plan to enable CS4223.
Without CS3210, CS3220, or CG3207, CS4223 cannot be taken in any semester.
